prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one concept comparison for a 2D combat-game character; concept presentation only, not a production sprite. Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and absolute identity/layout authority. Image 2 is rendering-principle inspiration only: readable graphic shape grouping and intentional angular pixel clusters. Image 3 is rendering-principle inspiration only: sculptural, selectively weathered pixel material treatment. Do not copy either screenshot’s characters, environments, motifs, or palette. Primary request: Restyle Image 1 into an ORIGINAL graphic-hybrid pixel-art rendering while retaining this exact light-armored South Indian-inspired fighter. Scene/backdrop: retain Image 1’s same plain neutral off-white background, with no scenery, dramatic backdrop, magic, neon, cyberpunk, or effects. Subject: preserve the same recognizable warm medium-fair brown face in right-facing profile, expression, skin range, near-black half-tied long-hair silhouette, lean athletic slightly stylized body, light chest armor, one and only one silver forearm guard, compact hip sword, waist cloth, trousers, boots. Composition/framing: preserve Image 1’s 1024x1536 full canvas, full-body displayed height, camera, stance, facing, feet baseline, proportions, and silhouette. Do not crop, zoom, redraw a new character, alter pose, equipment, outfit, or background. Style/medium: contemporary ORIGINAL pixel art with genuine intentional cluster construction and crisp stepped edges at several useful cluster sizes; no pixel-filter overlay. Establish a coherent visual rule: broad flowing two-tone indigo cloth-shadow planes; deliberately selective lost-and-found contours; sharp angular silver ridge highlights ONLY on the existing single forearm guard; quiet low-contrast carved clusters within the hair and steel, framed by a clean readable half-tied hair silhouette; a restrained warm-rust focal accent only at the existing waist accent. Give the cloth graphic clarity and the steel/hair selective crafted texture without pasted split styles. Color palette: retain the anchor’s material-color roles: indigo main cloth, charcoal secondary armor and trousers, worn steel guard, small rust waist accent, near-black hair, warm brown skin. Keep base colors recognizable; only rendering shadows/highlights/contours may shift. Materials/textures: broad clean cloth planes; selective chiseled clusters at steel wear and hair interiors; no pores, noisy grain, random dithering, smooth painterly blur, photoreal rendering, or anatomical fantasy illustration. Constraints: change rendering language only. Preserve all listed identity, profile, hairstyle, build, pose, framing, full canvas, equipment, material roles, palette roles, and neutral background. Avoid: generic traditional chunky sprite rendering, mere recolor/sharpen/downsample, copied game-character motifs, gore, horror costume, greyscale replacement, ghost-pale skin, glow, flames, text, watermark.
